The structure of composition Mg4Ag4Sn8 (reduced formula MgAgSn2) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group P2_12_12_1 (No. 1), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Mg, Ag, and Sn centers each with 12 geometric neighbors in close-packed-like local arrangements; one Sn orbit has 12 neighbors (2 Ag, 4 Mg, 6 Sn) within 3.02–3.22 Å. The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 16 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among the 12-vertex coordination polyhedra.
